onboarding.error: Could not save. Check your entries and connection, then try again.
onboarding.welcomeHelp: Let’s set up your profile, nutrition targets and meal-scanning AI. Each step explains what to enter. You can return to this guide from Settings at any time. Saved changes take effect immediately; closing the guide does not undo them.
onboarding.profileHelp:
Enter your current weight in kilograms, height in centimetres and date of birth.

Gender is used by the energy-estimation formula.

Choose activity based on a typical week: sedentary for mostly sitting, light for occasional exercise, moderate for regular exercise, and active or very active for physically demanding days.

Save your profile to see an estimated maintenance calorie need (TDEE).

This is an estimate, not medical advice.
onboarding.targetHelp:
Empty fields are prefilled from your saved profile: maintenance calories, protein at 1.2 g/kg, fat at 1 g/kg, and carbohydrates for the remaining energy. Live gram equivalents appear below the percentages.

Review and adjust the starting values below before saving. “min” means at least, “=” means around and “max” means at most. Fibre, salt, sugar and saturated fat are in grams. Save applies the target from today.
onboarding.aiHelp:
Manual food logging works without an API key.

For AI scanning, choose Gemini or OpenAI.

For Gemini, open Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey), sign in, create an API key and copy it.

For OpenAI, open platform.openai.com/api-keys, create a key and check billing/credits.

Use the information button beside the API key for the provider link.

Paste the key below and Save.

The key is kept in this browser (not synced between devices) and sent to our server to contact the provider.

Photos and dictated meal text are sent for recognition.

Never share your key.

Provider availability, quotas and charges vary.

A server-provided key may already allow scanning without your own key.

Saving here does not verify the key; try a scan afterwards.
onboarding.readyHelp:
Choose a meal type, then take a photo, select an image, use voice input, or add a food manually.

Always review recognised foods and portion weights before confirming.

Check the daily summary against your target.

You can change Profile, Target and AI settings or restart this guide at any time.

Setup progress is saved to your account and follows you across devices. Your API key stays in this browser.

target.recommendationMissing: Save a complete profile to calculate maintenance calories and weight-based targets. If your calorie goal cannot accommodate the protein and fat amounts, review it with a professional.
target.defaultsNote: Adjustable starting points for adults, not medical advice: fibre ≥25 g/day, salt ≤5 g/day; saturated fat and the app’s total logged sugar budget each use 10% of calories. The sugar budget is not a free-sugar recommendation: food totals also include naturally occurring sugar. Review these values for your needs. Existing entries are preserved; “Use recommended values” replaces the form, and Save applies it.
